game:blockdesc-kilnshelf*:
Place in a beehive kiln to fit more raw pottery.
Mod: Stackable Kiln Shelves
game:block-handbooktext-kilnshelf*: Four kiln shelf supports in the offhand and one kiln shelf plate in the mainhand can be used to place a new kiln shelf or upgrade an existing one.
kilnshelves:blockdesc-kilnplate-fired: Used with kiln shelf supports to build kiln shelves.
kilnshelves:blockdesc-kilnsupport-fire-f: Used with a kiln shelf plate to build kiln shelves.
